transcript: Yo kaise ho guys? Apple Pay finally finally India mein launch ho gaya aur main aapko dikhata hoon kaise aap apne banks ke card yahan pe daal sakte ho. Filhaal maine mere Axis ke andar dekha uske andar available tha ki main mere Apple wallet ke andar daal sakta hoon. Toh main basically mera Axis ka card yahan pe add kar raha hoon My Zone ka jaise aap dekh rahe ho yeh credit card hai mera, toh wahan pe maine bas khaali click kiya add karne ke liye kyunki pehle hi maine mere iPhone ke wallet mein daal diya tha, yeh mere Apple Watch ke wallet mein ja raha hai. Toh automatically wahan pe ek direct button aa gaya add to Apple Watch basically aur wahan ke yeh saare steps hain. To aap dekh hi rahe ho ye yahan pe maine terms and conditions thode agree kar liye jo pade hue the. Ab ye add karne ke liye process ke andar start hoga aur ye added bhi ho gaya. Zyada time bhi nahi laga. Ab ye card ko verify kar sakte hain. Ya to main mobile banking app ya to text message jo main yahan pe choose karunga aur OTP mere SIM pe aayega. Aur ye automatically activate bhi ho gaya kyonki usne direct hi bypass kar liya vo saare OTP sab pakad ke, so there you go it's added Apple Watch pe aa gaya.
